name: מֵשָׁא
summary: Mesha is the place from which the territory of Joktan’s descendants is traced toward Sephar. Its derivation is unknown.

evidence.note: מִמֵּשָׁא gives the starting point of their settlement, and בֹּאֲכָה סְפָרָה traces its extent toward Sephar.

note: Moved from the former word entry `meexaa2`. The old root key משא recorded the consonants of the place name. Its derivation is unknown. The men named Mesha (מֵישָׁע, מֵישָׁא, מֵישַׁע) spell the name otherwise.
